remarks: Over 2,700 square feet of impeccably finished living space and a layout that does double duty. This beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home blends classic charm with rare flexibility. Upstairs, glowing hardwood floors and a light-filled, welcoming layout set the tone. But the real showstopper is downstairs: a fully finished lower level with its own kitchen, wood-burning fireplace, adding over 1,000 square feet of highly usable space. Think in-law suite, multi-generational living, high-end entertaining, or a private guest retreat the possibilities are wide open. Central air, an attached 2-car garage, and a coveted spot in a highly walkable East Norwalk neighborhood near top-rated schools round out the package. Professional photos and full details drop soon. Dual-living layouts like this don't come around often. Schedule a showing!
